tools.name: search_papers
tools.description: Search the biomedical papers ARN has read for words in their titles and abstracts, best match first. Supports "quoted phrases", OR and -exclusions. By default only papers ARN judged relevant to human aging; narrow by study type, category, body system, age link, preprint status, author or the date a

tools.name: list_papers
tools.description: The newest papers ARN has read, by the date they entered ARN, with the same filters as search_papers and an optional words filter. Use it for what is new in a category, study type or body system, or for one author's papers (author takes a name, or an author_id from get_paper).

tools.name: get_paper
tools.description: One paper with everything ARN knows about it: its judgement, the language it was published in with its own-language title when that is not English, every author with ORCID iD and institutions, ARN's full story (headline, body, why it matters, caveats) when published, and the entities and claims extr

tools.name: list_stories
tools.description: Stories ARN wrote about new papers and published, newest first, each checked against its paper: a plain-language headline, body, why it matters and caveats, with the paper. Narrow by category, body system, study type or publication date.

tools.name: find_entities
tools.description: Find what papers are about: interventions such as drugs and diets, genes, biological processes, diseases, biomarkers, organisms, methods, hallmarks and more, most-studied first. Pass a result's type and key to get_entity.

tools.name: get_entity
tools.description: One entity, such as intervention rapamycin or disease sarcopenia, with the papers that involve it, newest first, and the role it plays in each. For an intervention, a gene or a process, `evidence` gives its evidence as structure, never as a grade: the species its findings reach and whether independe

tools.name: list_claims
tools.description: Findings extracted from papers as subject, relation and object (for example rapamycin extends_lifespan in Mus musculus), with effect size, conditions and the paper. Narrow by subject, object, relation, organism or paper.

tools.name: list_trials
tools.description: Clinical trials from ClinicalTrials.gov that bear on human aging, newest registry update first: phase, status, sponsor, size, conditions, interventions and the latest change. Narrow by words, phase, recruitment status, focus, industry sponsor or update date.

tools.name: get_trial
tools.description: One clinical trial by its registry number (NCT, ISRCTN, ChiCTR, CTRI, CTIS and the rest), with the registry's summary, outcomes and dates, every change ARN recorded and the papers that cite it. A record from the WHO ICTRP carries its attribution and the day WHO processed it, to show with it.

tools.name: list_news
tools.description: News about aging research and the longevity industry (companies, funding, trial results, regulators, policy, conferences), one story per event, newest first, in ARN's words with a link to every outlet that covered it. Narrow by words, kind or date.

tools.name: list_grants
tools.description: Research grants that bear on human aging, from NIH, the EU (CORDIS), UKRI and Wellcome, judged for aging as papers are, newest award first: title, funder, holder, investigators, amount, funded period, scheme and a link to the record. Narrow by an entity the title names (type:key, as find_entities gi

tools.name: list_conferences
tools.description: The conference calendar for aging research and age-related disease: meetings still to come or on, soonest first, then recent ones, each edition with its dates, place and how many of its abstracts ARN holds. Read one, and an edition's abstracts, with get_conference.

tools.name: get_conference
tools.description: One conference by its id from list_conferences, with its organiser, site and every edition. With `edition`, that edition's abstracts worth reading, the most relevant first, each with its number, format and the paper it was later published as. Read an abstract in full with get_paper.

tools.name: list_assets
tools.description: Drug and therapy programmes in development (assets), furthest stage first: each with its developers and partners, code names, modality, targets, mechanism, indications with the stage of each, hallmarks of aging and lifespan evidence. Narrow by target (a gene symbol such as GLP1R, or a process), mech

tools.name: get_asset
tools.description: One asset by its key or any code name (ubx1325, UBX-1325, BMS-986278): its developers, partners and licensors, targets, mechanism, modality, every indication with its stage and the trial or source behind it, its lifespan evidence and the news that names it. An account whose plan includes drug and th

tools.name: count_pipeline
tools.description: How many drug and therapy programmes there are, grouped by stage, modality, target, hallmark, indication, the developer's country or the developer, with each group's count at each stage. Takes list_assets' filters: by=target with indication=obesity counts the targets of obesity programmes. An accoun

tools.name: follow
tools.description: Use this when the user asks to follow a drug, gene, process, disease or other entity on AgingResearch.News, so its new papers reach them. Takes the type and key that find_entities or get_entity give. Following is saved to the user's ARN account: new papers on it appear in For you and the daily follo

tools.name: unfollow
tools.description: Use this when the user asks to stop following a drug, gene, process or other entity on AgingResearch.News. Takes the type and key that list_follows, find_entities or get_entity give. Removes the follow from the user's ARN account.

tools.name: list_follows
tools.description: Use this when the user asks what they follow on AgingResearch.News. Lists the drugs, genes, processes and saved searches their ARN account follows, newest first, each with its page on ARN; an entity's id is the type:key that unfollow takes.

tools.name: list_questions
tools.description: Use this when the user asks about questions they asked AgingResearch.News (Ask) before. Lists their most recent conversations, newest first, each with its title and its address on ARN, where the answer and its sources are.

tools.name: open_arn
tools.description: Use this when the user asks to open AgingResearch.News or to see their ARN feed, follows and recent questions in one place. Shows the newest stories ARN wrote (For you when the user is signed in, else Top), what they follow and their recent questions, with search.

tools.name: list_feed
tools.description: The sidebar's feed: For you or Top, as story cards.

tools.name: search_arn
tools.description: The sidebar's search: entities and papers matching words, as cards.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: open_arn, list_feed · Private data: get_trial, list_grants, list_assets, get_asset, count_pipeline · Public sink: follow · Destructive: get_conference.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: open_arn, list_feed · Private data: get_trial, list_grants, list_assets, get_asset, count_pipeline · Public sink: follow · Destructive: get_conference

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
